text: EFAP is structured to provide rapid recovery and medium-term resilience, aligning urgent rehabilitation with long-term risk reduction and social safeguards. It includes a multi-component structure focusing on roads, bridges, and agricultural water management. The project integrates multi-hazard-resilient design criteria and establishes a comprehensive safeguards architecture with a Draft Environmental and Social Management Framework. Transparency and citizen engagement are emphasized through public portals and grievance mechanisms.
